title: Performance Mode (SettingsAndHelp)

scenarios.title: Performance Mode applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Performance Mode (BtnPerformanceMode) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.
